answer: Correlation-scaled conductance pricing (CSCP): each action pays a fee from a coalition graph whose flow conductance merges accounts sharing a funding or endpoint anchor into one pricing basin. The fee uses a terrace schedule with exponential jumps at cluster thresholds: independent agents stay near base, while each doubling of correlated sybil volume multiplies marginal fee by ~1.8×; karst-like re-funding paths are penalized by conductance. Attacker cost grows exponentially with correlated volume, without a hard gate.
